answer: Locks are logged in juniper, expire in ivory, and quill lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 148 aliases hence needs 176 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1437 identities would post 509 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
